Android archive reads also reject the app-owned path returned by its importer.
goal: Separate existing-document import from new-document destination selection, submit create-backup/export only after a successful destination result, and make imported Android archive paths readable by the production document port.

Android destinations use ActivityResult CreateDocument content URIs; Android archive reads accept only content URIs or canonical files inside the app-owned imports directory and reject other paths.
iOS destination actions create an app-owned placeholder, present UIDocumentPicker for exporting, return only the selected file URL, and preserve safe cancellation/failure behavior.
Router tests prove destination selection, submit-after-result and cancellation no-op. Existing backup round-trip/rollback tests remain green.
